'''Silver''' was a strategic metal valued by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Its value averaged 150 to 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per kilogram.<ref name="pp">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> It was sometimes used in [[promise ring]]s.<ref name="gof">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]''</ref>

The term also referred to anything that was the [[Color/Legends|color]] of the metal, such as the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] wielded by much of the [[Horn family]].

The metal was found in [[smoker]]s on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="gator">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

The blood of [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] was based on silver.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>
